# Aditya Verma — full text

Aditya Verma is a systems and backend developer, electronics engineering student and
open-source maintainer based in Mumbai, India (UTC+05:30). He writes C, C++, Rust and
Python for low-level, embedded and backend work: firmware for ESP32 and Arduino boards,
Linux systems tooling, Wayland compositor utilities, Discord bots, REST APIs and machine
learning experiments. He runs Arch Linux (plus a Void-based distro he calls EclipseLinux),
maintains packages in the Arch Linux User Repository (AUR), and founded the open-source
community TheCodeVerseHub. His focus areas are systems programming, embedded engineering,
and the intersection of AI and hardware. Motto: "Code. Study. Research. Repeat."

## Biography

- Name: Aditya Verma
- Username / GitHub handle: youngcoder45
- Title: Systems & Backend Developer
- Location: Mumbai, India (IST, UTC+05:30)

- Experience:
  - AUR Maintainer, Arch Linux User Repository (2024–present)
  - Independent / Open Source Programmer (2021–present)
  - Founder, TheCodeVerseHub (2023–present)

## Skills

- Systems & low-level: C, C++, Rust, Shell/POSIX, Linux (Arch, Void), networking
- Embedded & hardware: ESP32 (ESP-IDF, Wi-Fi, MQTT), Arduino (AVR), Raspberry Pi, Embedded C, IoT
- Backend & services: Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, SQLite, MongoDB, Node.js/TypeScript
- Data & ML: NumPy, Pandas, scikit-learn, OpenCV, MediaPipe, Matplotlib, Jupyter
- DevOps & infra: Docker, CI/CD (GitHub Actions), Linux servers (systemd, nginx), monitoring
- Web (secondary): HTML/CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, Astro, React/Next

## Notable projects

- niri-utils — Rust; tooling for the niri scrollable-tiling Wayland compositor
- EclipseLinux — Lua/Void; a Linux distribution ("distro") built on top of Void Linux
- eigen-bot — Python; Discord bot
- OpenCV-Math-Solver — Python; solves math problems via computer vision
- discord-matrix-bridge — TypeScript; bridges Discord and Matrix
- Discord-Server-Exporter-Bot — Python; exports Discord server data via API
- CodeVerseHub-Website — TypeScript/Next.js; website for TheCodeVerseHub community
- Student-Performance-Predictor — Python; machine learning prediction of student performance

## Technical notes

- "What a compositor actually is (and why I run niri)" — Wayland, X11, compositors
- "A TUI with zero curses: raw C and termios" — terminal UI programming in C
- "GPIO as a state machine: bare-metal ESP32 in C vs Rust" — embedded firmware
- "Version your brain: dotfiles as infrastructure" — dotfiles, config management
